title: Open Withholding registry-backed locals (sidecar)
description: A centrally-published register of local rates (Pennsylvania's DCED Act 32 EIT register) kept as a CSV next to this sidecar. The engine expands every CSV row into one parameter file (DESIGN §3.6); the sidecar carries the provenance, the method and rounding every expansion shares, and the CSV's own hash so a hand edit to the CSV fails validation.

jurisdiction.description: Parent state of every expanded jurisdiction

sha256.description: Hash of the archived register bytes as downloaded (the .xls)

file.description: CSV in the same directory as this sidecar

sha256.description: Hash of the CSV bytes; validation fails on mismatch

key.description: CSV column holding the local identifier (psd_code)

resident_rate.description: CSV column for the resident rate

nonresident_rate.description: CSV column for the nonresident rate

rows.description: Data rows in the CSV (the complete register, zero-rate rows included)

expanded_rows.description: Rows with a nonzero rate, each becoming one parameter file; both-zero rows produce none (no file = no tax)
